summary: Japanese splits nominal copular predication from adjective predication and from animate/inanimate existence/location.

semantic_map.SEM.CLASSIFICATION_ROLE: だ/です with class/role nominal predicates
semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: i-adjectives predicate without だ; na-adjective/nominal predicates use copular morphology
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: state predicate according to adjective/verb class; no single all-purpose be form
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: resultant/state constructions such as ～ている or lexical state predicates where appropriate
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: いる for animate; ある for inanimate, with location marked by に
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: event-specific predicates such as 行われる/ある; do not force entity-existence rules
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: いる for animate; ある for inanimate
semantic_map.SEM.ABSENCE_NONEXISTENCE: いない for animate; ない for inanimate
semantic_map.SEM.TIME_DATE_PREDICATION: だ/です in nominal time/date predication where a copula is used
semantic_map.SEM.MATERIAL_COMPOSITION: ～でできている / ～からできている
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: possessor + に + ある/いる is a core existential-style possession pattern
